title: A cohesive class grows longer and takes another dependency

consumerGuidance.architecture: OrderPlacement owns the single responsibility of placing an order: validate, reserve stock, persist, return the result.
consumerGuidance.notes: The new dependency is a stock reservation service used only within that responsibility. Reservation failure uses the existing OrderPlacementResult contract.

forbiddenFindings.example: Reporting that the class is now 96 lines or that the constructor takes five parameters.
Reporting a single-responsibility violation without naming two independently changing policies and the coupling.
Requiring the method be split into a command handler, pipeline behavior or facade.
Objecting to the number of early returns or to local variable naming.

notes: Direct counterexample to entangled-policies: more code and more dependencies inside one coherent responsibility is not an SRP finding.
